headline: Former First Lady Bidisha Ershad arrested in fraud case
summary: Bidisha Ershad, former wife of late president Hussain Muhammad Ershad, was apprehended at a Gulshan café on the basis of a 2008 court warrant.
details: Police arrested Bidisha Ershad, the former wife of late president and Jatiya Party founder Hussain Muhammad Ershad, at Arabika Coffee in Dhaka's Gulshan area around 8:30 pm this evening.
The arrest follows a fraud case filed at Gulshan Police Station on February 28, 2008, under Section 420 of the Penal Code.
According to Mohammad Daud Hossain, officer-in-charge of Gulshan Police Station, a charge sheet was submitted in 2008 and the court subsequently found Bidisha guilty.
The court sentenced her to two years in prison and imposed a fine of Tk 10,000.
Police acted on an arrest warrant issued by the court to carry out the apprehension.
caption:
Arrested at a café in Gulshan: Former First Lady Bidisha Ershad is back in legal trouble over a 16-year-old fraud case.

Police arrested Bidisha Ershad, the former wife of late president and Jatiya Party founder Hussain Muhammad Ershad, at Arabika Coffee in Dhaka's Gulshan area around 8:30 pm this evening.

The arrest follows a fraud case filed at Gulshan Police Station on February 28, 2008, under Section 420 of the Penal Code.

According to Mohammad Daud Hossain, officer-in-charge of Gulshan Police Station, a charge sheet was submitted in 2008 and the court subsequently found Bidisha guilty.

The court sentenced her to two years in prison and imposed a fine of Tk 10,000.

Police acted on an arrest warrant issued by the court to carry out the apprehension.

headline_marked: 5,310 yaba pills seized: [[Police ASI jailed for drug trafficking]] in Uttara
headline: 5,310 yaba pills seized: Police ASI jailed for drug trafficking in Uttara
summary: An assistant sub-inspector from Pallabi Police Station and another man were arrested after police recovered thousands of yaba pills from multiple locations in Dhaka.
details: Police have arrested an assistant sub-inspector (ASI) and another man with 5,310 yaba pills in Dhaka's Uttara. The arrestees are Md Shafiqul Islam, 43, an ASI at Pallabi Police Station, and 24-year-old Wasim.
The operation began early Monday when Dakshinkhan Police raided the Azampur kitchen market area based on a tip-off. Officers caught Wasim as he attempted to flee, recovering 50 yaba pills from him.
Following Wasim's information, police raided a house and arrested ASI Shafiqul Islam with 200 yaba pills. A subsequent raid on a flat in Bismillah Polli's Noor Building recovered another 5,060 pills.
During primary interrogation, the duo confessed to bringing yaba from different parts of the country to sell in Dakshinkhan and adjacent areas.
A case was filed under the Narcotics Control Act at Dakshinkhan Police Station on Monday. A court later sent both suspects to jail.
Pallabi Police Station OC Hasan Basir noted that ASI Shafiqul had joined the station on June 8 and had frequently neglected his duties, often citing illness as an excuse.
caption:
